info.name: AixBOMS data stack - hogwarts
info.description:
Tests for the generated hogwarts-service (Harry Potter wizards, houses and spells): views, namespaced GraphQL, CRUD, inheritance, JSON attributes, the 1-to-N and M-to-N relationships, both business rules and the error codes.

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or `newman run`): requests save ids that later requests use. Needs the demo data (demo.seed=true). Each run uses its own names and deletes what it created.

Works against the model running on its own or inside datastack-server: set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080). `api` is the model's REST base path, /api/hogwarts.

item.name: 1 Views (demo data)
item.description: Read-only checks on the Harry Potter demo data, through the three views. Saves ids used later.

exec: // New suffix for every run, so names never clash with earlier runs

pm.test("stag patronus, holly wand (JSON attribute)", () => { pm.expect(harry.patronus).to.eql("Stag"); pm.expect(harry.wand.wood).to.eql("Holly"); pm.expect(harry.wand.core).to.eql("Phoenix feather"); });

pm.test("spells carry level, favourite and the spell", () => harry.spells.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.level).to.be.within(1, 9); pm.expect(s.favourite).to.be.a("boolean"); pm.expect(s.spell).to.have.property("incantation"); }));
pm.test("Ron and Ginny", () => pm.expect(names).to.include.members(["Ron Weasley", "Ginny Weasley"]));

item.name: Professors show their subject (subtype in a supertype view)

exec: pm.test("Snape is a professor of Potions", () => { pm.expect(snape.type).to.eql("PROFESSOR"); pm.expect(snape.subject).to.eql("Potions"); });

item.name: Spell book: Avada Kedavra and its casters (M-to-N from the spell side)

exec: pm.test("the Killing Curse is unforgivable", () => { pm.expect(avada.name).to.eql("Killing Curse"); pm.expect(avada.category).to.eql("CURSE"); pm.expect(avada.unforgivable).to.be.true; });
pm.test("cast by Voldemort, Bellatrix and Snape", () => pm.expect(casters).to.include.members(["Tom Riddle", "Bellatrix Lestrange", "Severus Snape"]));
pm.test("casters come with level and house", () => avada.casters.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c.level).to.be.at.least(7); pm.expect(c.wizard.house.name).to.be.a("string"); }));
pm.test("Slytherin's ghost is the Bloody Baron", () => pm.expect(byName.Slytherin.ghost).to.eql("The Bloody Baron"));

pm.test("Gryffindor has students and professors", () => { const types = byName.Gryffindor.members.map(m => m.type); pm.expect(types).to.include("WIZARD"); pm.expect(types).to.include("PROFESSOR"); });

item.name: 2 GraphQL
item.description: The same views through /graphql. Every view lives in the model's namespace: { hogwarts { ... } }.

item.name: Namespaced query: houses and their members

exec: pm.test("professors have a subject, students do not", () => houses.flatMap(h => h.members).forEach(m => m.type === "PROFESSOR" ? pm.expect(m.subject).to.be.a("string") : pm.expect(m.subject).to.be.null));

item.name: Only the fields you ask for

exec: pm.test("Luna is the only Lovegood", () => { pm.expect(view.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(view.items[0].name).to.eql("Luna Lovegood"); pm.expect(view.items[0].house.name).to.eql("Ravenclaw"); });

item.name: Many-to-many from the spell side: who casts Expelliarmus

exec: pm.test("many casters, highest level first", () => { const levels = charm.casters.map(c => c.level); pm.expect(levels.length).to.be.at.least(5); pm.expect(levels).to.eql([...levels].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
pm.test("hogwarts is deployed", () => pm.expect(hogwarts).to.include({ rest: "/api/hogwarts", graphql: "hogwarts", schema: "hogwarts" }));

item.name: Views are only reachable through the namespace
3 Houses (CRUD)
item.description: Create, read, update and the error cases on a house of our own.

exec: pm.test("created with version 0", () => { pm.expect(b.name).to.eql(`Ilvermorny ${pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")}`); pm.expect(b.version).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.ghost).to.be.null; });
pm.test("ghost set, other fields unchanged", () => { pm.expect(b.ghost).to.include("Wampus"); pm.expect(b.founder).to.eql("Isolt Sayre"); });

item.name: 4 Spells (CRUD, enum, defaults)
item.description: Spells of our own: an ordinary charm and an unforgivable curse for the rule tests.

exec: pm.test("difficulty 3, name unchanged", () => { pm.expect(b.difficulty).to.eql(3); pm.expect(b.name).to.include("Tickling Charm"); });

item.name: 5 Wizards and professors (inheritance, JSON attribute)
item.description: A student in our house and a professor in Ravenclaw: two types in one table.

item.name: Create wizard with a wand (JSON attribute)

exec: pm.test("a WIZARD in our house", () => { pm.expect(b.type).to.eql("WIZARD"); pm.expect(b.houseId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("houseId")); });
pm.test("wand stored as JSON", () => pm.expect(b.wand).to.eql({ wood: "Hornbeam", core: "Unicorn hair", lengthInches: 10.5 }));
pm.test("no subject for a student", () => pm.expect(b.subject).to.be.null);
pm.test("a PROFESSOR with a subject", () => { pm.expect(b.type).to.eql("PROFESSOR"); pm.expect(b.subject).to.eql("Defence Against the Dark Arts"); });

item.name: Get the professor as a wizard (subtype through the supertype)

exec: pm.test("type and subject come along", () => { pm.expect(b.type).to.eql("PROFESSOR"); pm.expect(b.subject).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Year of birth out of range → 400

exec: pm.test("professor in Ravenclaw", () => { pm.expect(w.type).to.eql("PROFESSOR"); pm.expect(w.subject).to.eql("Memory Charms (retired)"); pm.expect(w.house.name).to.eql("Ravenclaw"); });

item.name: 6 House members (1-to-N, restrict delete)
item.description: Moving wizards between houses; a house with members cannot be deleted.

item.name: Roster: our house has two members, Ravenclaw lost one

exec: pm.test("Colin and Lockhart in our house", () => pm.expect(ours.members.map(m => m.name.split(" ")[1])).to.have.members(["Creevey", "Lockhart"]));
pm.test("Lockhart no longer in Ravenclaw", () => pm.expect(ravenclaw.members.map(m => m.name)).not.to.include(`Gilderoy Lockhart ${pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")}`));
